blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Each family of functions has a signature. Learn to spot it in a graph, an equation or a table, and you can choose a model and predict.

blocks.title: End behavior
items: Even degree, positive lead: both ends up
Even degree, negative lead: both ends down
Odd degree, positive lead: down left, up right
Odd degree, negative lead: up left, down right

blocks.title: Rational function asymptotes
items: Vertical: denominator zero and not cancelled
Equal degrees: ratio of leading coefficients
Top degree larger: no horizontal asymptote

blocks.body: Do not trust a model far outside the range of its data.
